guidance.text: Write the system as one JSON object a program could read. things: one object per part or actor, with name, kind and what it does. quantities: one object per measured value, with thing, name, value, unit and when it holds. links: one object per connection or cause, with from, to, relation and condition. events: one object per thing that happens, with when, what and effect. rules: one string per rule, written 'if <condition> then <consequence>'. unknowns: one string per thing the description leaves open. Use the exact names, numbers and units from the description; never invent a value.

name: JSON
notes: one checked JSON object: things, quantities, links, events, rules, unknowns (human, run 5)
